title: PyTorch on TPU: Hands On With Colab
why_read: A concrete, benchmarked walkthrough of running PyTorch on Google Cloud TPUs with measured performance gains, useful for anyone evaluating TPU inference options outside the usual JAX ecosystem.
analysis: This tutorial-style piece measures PyTorch inference performance for Gemma 4 on a single TPU v5e chip, showing how a compiled decode step boosts throughput tenfold compared to standard Hugging Face generation, and how a ring cache extends usable context to the model's full 131,072 tokens. It directly compares these PyTorch optimizations against a native JAX engine on identical hardware, giving a grounded sense of the current performance gap. This is useful, concrete benchmarking information for engineers deciding between PyTorch and JAX for TPU-based inference workloads. The level of specific, reproducible detail, exact token-per-second numbers and notebook links, makes it more credible than typical promotional AI content.
